name: sh.fettle/mcp
title: Fettle
description: Uptime monitoring for developers — monitors, incidents, heartbeats, maintenance, status pages

environmentVariables.name: FETTLE_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Fettle API key (Settings → API Keys at https://fettle.sh). Read scope lists and inspects; write scope is needed to create, change or pause anything.

environmentVariables.name: FETTLE_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the Fettle API. Only set this to point the server at something other than production.

environmentVariables.name: FETTLE_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: How long one tool call may take before it is abandoned.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Fettle API key as a bearer token: "Bearer fettle_…". The same key the npm package takes in FETTLE_API_KEY.
